rows.grounds: past participle used adjectivally in nominative plural

items.question: In which eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are beings said to be tormented?
items.inference: The verse identifies eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams as sites of torment.
uncertainties: The exact referent of yoniyantreṣu is not specified.
The grammatical gender of pīḍitāḥ is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, they are tormented.
